episodes.synopsis: Happy-go-lucky boy Shu encounters a mysterious girl, and is drawn into time warp that thrusts him into a hellish future.
episodes.title: A Girl Admiring the Sunset

episodes.synopsis: Lala-Ru is captured by Abelia’s men, but her magical pendant escapes with Shu at the last moment.
episodes.title: A Boy and a Mad King

episodes.synopsis: While imprisoned, Shu meets a fragile blue-eyed girl named Sara who found her way to this hellish future under similar circumstances.
episodes.title: A Feast in the Dark

episodes.synopsis: The young soldiers have their marching orders: Search the entire ship from top to bottom for Lala-Ru’s missing pendant.
episodes.title: Discord

episodes.synopsis: King Hamdo’s frustration reaches a boiling point as the mission to recover the pendant continues to be fruitless.
episodes.title: Murder

episodes.synopsis: The young soldiers are now faced with a tour of duty as they leave Hellywood to seek more soldiers.
episodes.title: Disappearance in a Sandstorm

episodes.synopsis: While in prison, Shu uncovers an unbelievable mystery and the fate of this hellish future suddenly falls squarely in his hands.
episodes.title: Night of Flight

episodes.synopsis: Now that Shu is on the run, he must face a whole new set of dangers in the wild desert.
episodes.title: Two Lone Souls

episodes.synopsis: Shu and Lala-ru don’t realize it, but the village they’ve encountered is actually the target of King Hamdo’s revenge.
episodes.title: In the Chasm

episodes.synopsis: Shu and Lala-Ru are tentatively welcomed by the villagers of Zari Bars.
episodes.title: Prelude to Chaos

episodes.synopsis: Sis, one of the citizens of Zari Bars, finds Sara in the desert, on the verge of death.
episodes.title: Eve of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: Sara warns the people of Zari Bars that an impending attack from Hellywood is eminent.
episodes.title: This Bloody Earth

episodes.synopsis: Nabuca finds himself at a crossroad: Continue killing for the empty promise of going home after the war ends, or listen to his heart and put down his gun.
episodes.title: Now and Then, Here and There
